description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the DefaultMetadataHeader class, which is a final, immutable class implementing the MetadataHeader interface. It provides methods to create, parse, and compare metadata header instances, including JSON serialization/deserialization. It appears to be part of a larger metadata handling component within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers.metadata package.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeader
classes.description: An immutable implementation of MetadataHeader providing storage for a key-value pair, with JSON serialization and parsing capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultMetadataHeader instance with specified key and value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a DefaultMetadataHeader from a JSON object, extracting the key and value fields.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with this metadata header.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with this metadata header.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this header to another for ordering based on key and value.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this header into a JSON object.
